basis.quote: For the last two days my stools have been black and tarry
basis.interpretation: Black tarry stools (melena) indicate upper gastrointestinal bleeding, a time-critical condition requiring emergency evaluation and intervention.

basis.quote: I've felt lightheaded when I stand up
basis.interpretation: Orthostatic lightheadedness in the context of melena suggests possible hemodynamic compromise from ongoing or recent GI blood loss.

output.reason: Melena with orthostatic symptoms indicates active or recent upper GI bleeding requiring immediate emergency assessment, resuscitation capability and likely endoscopic intervention.
output.patientMessage: Go to the nearest emergency department now. Do not drive yourself if lightheadedness is severe; call 911 for safe transport if needed. Black tarry stools with dizziness on standing require urgent evaluation for bleeding.
